'''Devilsquid''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] that dwelt within the deepest regions of the oceans of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], such as [[Devil's Crevasse]]. They were far larger than an adult Human and known for being aggressive predators. They were highly similar in both name and appearance to [[demonsquid]] of [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]].

In [[137 ABY]], [[Master]] [[Treis Sinde]] of the [[Imperial Knight]]s used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] [[Animal bond|to command]] a large number of Devilsquid to [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse|attack]] a [[Sea Leviathan]], a [[Sithspawn/Legends|creature]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|created]] by the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] of the [[One Sith]] to bring about the [[Genocide on Dac|extermination]] of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. The squid overpowered the monster, and pulled the beast into their lair where they subsequently devoured it.
